meta.name: My Secret Romance 720p
meta.description: A partying chaebol has a one-night stand with a beautiful girl. When she joins his company years later, it is difficult to hide their secret romance.

videos.title: The One Night Relationship
videos.overview: Cha Jin Wook is a spoiled rich kid forced to humble himself by taking on a summer job at his father's hotel. Lee Yoo Mi is a klutz who can't convince her mom she's fine without a boyfriend. When their paths collide, sparks fly.

videos.title: You've Deeply Insulted Me
videos.overview: When Yoo Mi gets hired on as a nutritionist at a large company, she is surprised to find out who is running it.

videos.title: My Insides Flip Like Pancakes
videos.overview: Yoo Mi copes with her new boss Cha Jin Wook's antics. Cha Jin Wook's ego is tested as Yoo Mi tries to keep the personal and the professional separate.

videos.title: The Secret in the Jewelry Box
videos.overview: Yoo Mi learns more about Cha Jin Wook's food preferences and stumbles upon a precious item in his home.

videos.title: Playing With My Heart
videos.overview: When misunderstandings drive a wedge both in and out of the office, Jin Wook realizes that he isn't the only one after Yoo Mi's affections.

videos.title: Let's Go to Work
videos.overview: Keeping work checked at the door won't be easy when Jin Wook and Yoo Mi strike a deal that stirs underlying emotions.

videos.title: This Is How Business Is Done
videos.overview: Engaging in a bit of offsite research may turn out to be useful for Yoo Mi's job and her relationships.

videos.title: You're My Paderella
videos.overview: Jin Wook and Yoo Mi take a stroll down memory lane wherein they learn more about each other's deepest secrets.

videos.title: Tell Me the Truth
videos.overview: Jin Wook begins to question how Dong Goo fits into Yoo Mi's life. In order to find out, he'll need to work backwards and put the puzzle pieces back together.

videos.title: A Tender Farewell
videos.overview: Just when romance starts to bloom, the rumor mill churns out news that puts Jin Wook and Yoo Mi's relationship in jeopardy.

videos.title: I'm the Only One Who Can't Date
videos.overview: Hidden feelings come to light while Jin Wook and Yoo Mi deal with the fallout of their separation. But will they be able to keep that distance between them for long?

videos.title: It's Time to Wake Up From This Dream
videos.overview: Getting away from it all sounds like a good idea to Yoo Mi, though she'll soon find that physical distance won't be enough to deal with underlying resentment.

videos.title: You're My World, Tonight
videos.overview: Yoo Mi is faced with the difficult choice of running away from her past or following her heart.

meta.slogan: An unbelievable moment, one night; A world full of you, tonight
